Sikandar Raza - We will bowl first.

Ibrahim Zadran - We wanted to bowl first, but we're batting now and we'll look to put up a good total on the board. We've some new players, and we want to give them confidence. We don't want them to be put under pressure; the senior guys are there, so we just want them to go out and enjoy the game.

A nice breeze is blowing, which should give the players a feeling of comfort. This is a fresh wicket and there's some grass covering, it means that the fast bowlers will get some movement,. Dew could come later on. Batting first, the team has won 6 times, batting second 4 times. However, the chasing teams have won the last four matches. This is a good pitch though and there are runs on offer.

Newman Nyamhuri to Rahmanullah Gurbaz, wide, Nyamhuri shortens the length and pushes one across the right-hander, but it's too far away from the batter and is called as a wide

Rashid settles under it at long-off and then lobs the ball to long-on. Newman Nyamhuri c Rashid Khan b Fazalhaq Farooqi 2(3)

22:02 Local Time, 18:02 GMT, 23:32 IST: Smiling faces in the Afghani camp as Ibrahim and others come for the post-match handshakes. Disappointing batting effort by Zimbabwe who never got going. Both the openers struggled before getting out and the middle-order fared no better. Only Ryan Burl showed some intent but he had no support from the others. Just when he seemed to be set for an onslaught he fell to a stunning one-hander by Kamal at extra-cover. It was always difficult against the Afghani spinners in the middle-overs and Zimbabwe were always behind the asking rate. At the end, Omarzai got nice reverse-swing to help himself to wickets. Wonder what Sikandar Raza will say about this performance as usually he is quite open and honest in his thoughts. Stay tuned for the post-match stuff...

Kamal 2/2: [On whether his all-round performances would make it difficult for the captain to leave him out of the playing XI.] Of course, it becomes difficult for the captain to leave you out when you are performing so well in every match. However, the final decision depends on the team and the squad, and the captain has to choose the best combination. My effort will always be to perform as well as I can in every match I play and prove myself for the team. Whenever I get an opportunity, I will give 100 per cent and do my best to contribute to the team's success.

Rashid 2/2: [On whether he feels extra pressure to deliver consistently with the ball and contribute to the team in every match.] Well, nothing much, you know, pressure. I feel like that's a kind of preparation I do as well while practicing that I make myself mentally ready for that. And I know the condition will be right there and there will be a time where team will needs (need) me in all three departments with the batting, bowling and fielding. And I have to put myself under pressure in the practice and as soon as I do well in the practice, it all goes back to the game. So nothing much, just making sure do the natural things and keep backing myself.

Ibrahim 2/2: [On how Afghanistan can maintain motivation and avoid becoming complacent while continuing their outstanding performances across all three formats.] Yeah, it's really important. We always think every single game to think about Afghanistan, think about, you know, the team, how to take it forward and how to, you know, develop ourselves. The motivation is there, you know, with the guys, and we have been working on that. And you saw today again the quality is there, you know, the beauty of the players is there. This is what we have been doing, and yeah, one day, you know, we will be at the top.
Afghanistan go 1-0 up in this three-match series. The 2nd game of the series is on the 29th. We will see you there. For now it's bye bye.
